_comment: Held-out set for the detection-quality test. novel_injections: phrasings that express a known malicious intent but are NOT near-duplicates of any CANONICAL_ATTACKS entry and are NOT matched by gateway/analyzer/rules.py (which needs specific word adjacency) — the similarity layer's intent-cluster co-occurrence is what should still catch them. hard_injections: blunt phrasings the regex layer is expected to catch, kept here so the confusion matrix has a rules-layer positive rate too. clean_commercial: realistic merchant copy and buyer intent that must NOT be flagged; a false positive here routes to REQUIRE_APPROVAL (one human review), it does not decline the purchase. If you add a novel phrasing the regex already catches, move it to hard_injections.
